params.prompt: Hero plate evoking the Stripe developer dashboard, in the Stripe brand world. Cinematic product still: 50mm lens at f1.8, shallow depth of field, soft cool key light, premium studio, filmic grade, glossy reflective surface, centered composition, Apple-keynote look. Color palette is unmistakably Stripe: deep navy background (#0A2540), indigo-violet accent glow (#635BFF), bright cyan highlights (#80E9FF), white UI surfaces; smooth gradient mesh in violet-to-cyan. The interface is intentionally BLURRED and out of focus with heavy bokeh — NO readable text, NO legible labels, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos, NO wordmarks; only abstract glowing UI panels and charts as soft color blocks. Premium fintech, clean, modern, the feel of Stripe's marketing site.
